data.body: Held-out validation GREEN on first standard-tier implementation attempt: six original hidden happy/edge/crash/E2E nodes passed in 0.73s; defect-seeded bindings-first mutation drove the crash-boundary node RED and restoration returned green. Five-axis review found one missing sidecar-os.replace recovery case; under revert-first discipline it failed against pre-fix ordering, passed after restoration, and the full focused regression set is now 20 passed in 1.02s. Refactoring litmus: assertions target persisted JSON, reload ordering, real git commit contents, and exact fault boundaries, not private source structure. Implementer tier: standard/mid gpt-5.6-terra, one attempt; it saw only the happy-path test. Packed-cost measurement is deterministic across two runs on the pinned 40-revision corpus 46a2426a..5282e235: A2-1 1728.74 bytes/changed version, A2-2 1286.05, ratio 0.7439; A2-2 is ~10.1% of the epic 12.79 KB baseline. Command and method are recorded in docs/experiments/bridge-state-get-rotation-cutover.md.
